Name: Tall Wives - Long Leah
Author: ViolentFran
Description:
[size=2]Why? I just like how Leah looks when she is taller and with long legs.

[/size]One particularity of this mod is that it uses a framework mod I made specifically for this one, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42083]Idle Plus Walk[/url]. It's a simple mod that allows for sprite mods to use a unique idle pose without compromising the walk animation. It's necessary for the correct display of Long Leah.

[size=4][b]Installation:[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=2]Make sure you have SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/size]
[*]Extract the file into the mods folder.
[*]You will need IdlePlusWalk for this sprite mod to display correctly.
[/list][size=4]More Tall Wives[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42110]Long Leah[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43238]Huge Haley[/url]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Fixed a few sprites that were out of order.
